question: Who was known as the ‘Iron Man of India'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sardar Patel** was popularly called the **Iron Man of India. **
 
• He played an important role in the **Indian freedom struggle.**
 
• He became the **first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India.**
 
• He was one of the **conservative members of the Indian National Congress.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35d44f1e30594628eb1e7e84e42c0f42aeef23f5af5798319fa04e541da19fec.png]

• Subhas Chandra Bose is famous** for his role in India's independence movement**.​ 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was an important leader of Indian Independence Movement and **Indian National Congress.**
 
• PM Narendra Modi voted** 'world's most powerful leader 2019'** as a prime minister of India.
